findings.evidence: The instance bodies at lines 189 and 201 invoke `mvPolynomialEquiv R L (Module.Free.chooseBasis R L)` and have no `Unique` index or dependency on `polynomialEquiv` or `basisPow`; `mvPolynomialEquiv` is declared in `Abelian.lean`.
findings.fix: Move both instances (lines 188–201) to `UniversalEnveloping/Abelian.lean` near `mvPolynomialEquiv`/`basisMonomials`, adding the private Noetherian import there as needed.
findings.issue: `instIsDomain` and `instIsNoetherianRing` are not one-variable polynomial results: both apply to arbitrary free abelian Lie algebras and use only `mvPolynomialEquiv`, so placing them in the rank-one `Polynomial` module hides broadly applicable consequences behind an unrelated import.

summary: The rank-one polynomial material is naturally placed, but the two arbitrary-rank transfer instances belong beside the multivariable equivalence in `Abelian.lean`.
